transcript.text: The plastic catch on my Hotpoint dryer door has snapped and now the door won't stay shut so it won't start. Model TVFM70BGP. Can I just get a new catch?

[Heading: Broken door catch/handle assembly]
Yes, you can replace it. The door won't start because the interlock switch inside the frame isn't being engaged by the latch. You'll need to buy a new door handle and catch assembly for your Hotpoint TVFM70BGP. To fit it, unplug the dryer first, then remove the screws holding the front panel or the door hinge bracket (usually accessible from the top or side depending on the exact build), swap the broken plastic part, and reassemble. Once fitted, ensure the door clicks shut firmly before starting a cycle. I've found a matching part for model [object Object] — it's shown below; check the listing matches before ordering.

I can read the serial number off the label inside the door if that helps you find the exact part number. No burning smell, and I'll unplug it before fitting.

That green dot being an engineer-fitted fire safety modification is very useful information. It suggests the door frame or latch mechanism may have been altered from its original factory state, which means a standard off-the-shelf catch might not align correctly with that modification. I cannot provide specific part numbers, but to ensure you get the correct component that will work with both your model and that 2017 modification, please read the serial number off the label inside the door. You can then give the full model (TVFM70BGP) and serial number to a parts supplier or engineer to verify compatibility before ordering.
